narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Add the leaps. Seven plus five is twelve, and forty eight divided by twelve gives four leaps.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But both run the same way, so the five feet are already inside the seven feet.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The leaps do not add, so that slip is struck.
